about: Shared images, made once and reused by every chapter and lab that needs them (docs/family-app/13_IMAGE_GUIDE.md). Object cut-outs on a transparent background unless the kind says otherwise.

images.shows: An empty 250 mL borosilicate glass beaker with white graduation marks and a pouring lip
images.view: Straight front view at eye level, slight top-left light, faint reflection
images.right: Clear glass, white printed graduations, pouring lip at top left

images.view: Upright, front view; also a second file tilted 45 degrees
images.right: Thin clear glass, rolled rim

images.right: Plain wood, no brand

images.right: Thicker glass than a test tube
